headline: Committee discusses Bill 176 road agreement and Bill 1 on water department plan review

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The committee took up Bill 176, a 10-year road maintenance agreement with the state, and Bill 1, on reviewing subdivision plans before water is verified. A request to send Bill 1 to the Board of Water Supply was made, and the committee will work with County lawyers on the policy plan question.
meeting.recap: The Water and Infrastructure Committee met on January 26, 2026.[[0:00:30]] Bill 176 would let the mayor sign a 10-year road maintenance agreement with the state Department of Land and Natural Resources.[[0:03:40]] Bill 1 would let the water department review subdivision construction plans before water is verified, at the developer's risk.[[0:22:35]] The chair said developers must still show a long-term water source before final subdivision approval.[[0:22:50]] One testifier asked to defer the bill until the water director finishes a survey.[[0:29:54]] A land company representative said the bill could save four to 10 months of processing.[[0:47:16]] The water director said the bill has not gone to the Board of Water Supply.[[1:18:42]] A council member said the countywide policy plan calls for enough water before subdivision or construction documents are approved.[[1:41:08]] A council member asked to send the bill to the Board of Water Supply for comments.[[2:13:58]]
meeting.next: Staff will note a request to ask the state whether it sprays herbicides when maintaining the roads. The committee will work with the County's lawyers on the countywide policy plan question.

moments.q: "This bill does not eliminate Maui County's Show Me the Water requirements."
Policy plan read aloud: "ensure that adequate supplies of water are available prior to approval of subdivision or construction documents"

trackerIssues.title: Board of Water Supply opposes Bill 1

issues.oneLine: The committee is weighing Bill 1, which would let the Department of Water Supply review subdivision construction plans before water is verified.
issues.why: The chair said getting written water verification can take about three to six months, and plan review now waits for it.
issues.brief: The chair said developers must still get written verification of a long-term water source before final subdivision approval.[[#1]] A council member said the countywide policy plan calls for enough water before subdivision or construction documents are approved.[[#2]]
